# Archived ownership-migration fixture

These minimal wheels contain the actual eight `imbue/overlay` modules and
METADATA archived during the 2026-10-30 update incident. The wheel containers
and RECORD hashes were reconstructed offline; they are packaging fixtures,
not copies of production environments. No private cache or environment is included.

Source distributions: overlay 0.1.0 (mngr pin
445acdea9fbb34ce24f19e507fd0d7e1f4f7c4a0) and imbue-overlay 0.1.0 (mngr pin
6550c2b506f74cbffe4be6475bbe84ac26f97833). Both own the same eight Python paths.
The tests install these wheels offline in private final-prefix environments.

Wheel SHA-256:

- `imbue_overlay-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl`: `9e852c02d83fcf4df29767884f679a5abc38afdc36a84a1b8751efc111e86768`
- `overlay-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl`: `4b6b38efab21510144956c5ffab935213081bd2651cb9c2aa41d8b7aafbccb96`
